target_audience: Entrepreneurs and business leaders seeking financial clarity, optimization, business recovery, and profitability.
design_philosophy: E1 - Anti-AI Designer. Fusion of French premium editorial layout with a high-converting diagnostic funnel. 'Awwwards' level execution: kinetic typography, deliberate product photography framing, generous white space, and purposeful motion.

fonts.primary: font-sans (Poppins) for all structural headings and body text to ensure extreme clarity.
fonts.accent: font-handwriting (Caveat) for warm touches, signatures, annotations, and humanizing the premium feel.

hierarchy.h1: text-5xl md:text-6xl+ font-semibold tracking-tight leading-[1.1] text-[#0A100D]
hierarchy.overline: text-xs md:text-sm uppercase tracking-[0.2em] font-medium text-[#737875]

colors.archetype: French Premium Editorial (Stark Contrasts + Warm Accents)

interactive.cta_primary: bg-[#0A2E22] hover:bg-[#124233] text-white transition-all duration-300 shadow-[0_8px_30px_rgba(10,46,34,0.15)] hover:shadow-[0_8px_30px_rgba(10,46,34,0.25)] hover:-translate-y-1

visual_enhancers.radius: rounded-none md:rounded-sm (Keep edges relatively sharp for a premium, editorial feel, avoiding overly bubbly tech SaaS radius)
visual_enhancers.shadows: Ambient diffuse shadows for depth, never harsh. shadow-[0_20px_40px_rgba(0,0,0,0.04)]
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/80 border-b border-white/20 for sticky headers

grids.marketing_tetris: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-8 md:gap-12 (Use asymmetric spans like col-span-8 and col-span-4 for tension)

layouts.spacing: Generous Spacing Philosophy: p-8, p-12, py-24, py-32. Use 2-3x more spacing than typical templates.
layouts.alignment: Left-align dense text for readability. Use optical alignment. The main CTA must have 'breathing room' of at least py-12 around it.
layouts.social_proof: Social proof (stars, avatars, Trustpilot-style badges) MUST be positioned immediately below or adjacent to every primary CTA.

motion.libraries: framer-motion for interactions, lenis for smooth momentum scrolling
motion.hero_reveal: Masked line-by-line text reveal on mount (y: 100% to 0%, transition: { staggerChildren: 0.1, ease: [0.33, 1, 0.68, 1] })
motion.scroll_reveal: Subtle fade-in and slide-up (y: 30) triggered on scroll into view.
motion.hover_states: Micro-interactions on all cards: scale 1.02, subtle shadow increase.
motion.marquee: Use react-fast-marquee. Very slow, elegant, font-medium, separating major sections.

sections: Hero: H-screen parallax. Massive headline. Dominant CTA 'Faire mon diagnostic gratuit'. Subtle handwritten Caveat note 'En 2 minutes'.
Editorial Marquee: 'Clarté Financière • Optimisation • Reprise • Rentabilité'.
Value Proposition/Trust Stack: Asymmetric grid, client logos, count-up stats (framer-motion).
Diagnostic Teaser: High-contrast dark block to drive users to the quiz.

Diagnostic.flow: 6-8 steps interactive quiz. Use a progress bar.
Diagnostic.components: shadcn/ui RadioGroup wrapped in custom large clickable cards. Subtle transitions between steps.
Diagnostic.capture: Step 7 is an Email Capture form ('Vos résultats sont prêts, où vous les envoyer ?').
Diagnostic.results: Personalized dashboard feel: User Profile + 3 Key Levers + Recommended Service CTA (seamless bridge to Services).

Services.structure: 3 dedicated sections (Clarté, Optimisation, Reprise). Detailed breakdown with high readability.
Services.conversion: Dual path: Quick Form (shadcn Form/Input) AND 'Réserver un appel' (Calendly/Modal). Both lead to an elegant on-screen confirmation toast (sonner).

Boutique.layout: High-end editorial catalog. 6 products. Spotlight photography, clipped frames (aspect-square, gray backgrounds).
Boutique.checkout: Simulated checkout flow with Shadcn Dialog/Sheet. Pages: Success & Cancel.

Boxes.layout: Separate visual universe. Darker, more exclusive feel for 'Le Coffret Zayado' / 'L\'Édition Dirigeant'. 2 products.
Boxes.checkout: Shares the simulated boutique checkout logic.

Vision.layout: Text-heavy but highly stylized. Core values, secondary mention of TheSustain initiative, discrete mention of the 'Cockpit'.

image_urls.description: Minimalist premium office desk, perfect for the financial/reprise consulting sections to establish authority.
Luxury black and white gift boxes with bows, perfect representation of the 'Coffret Zayado' offering.
Modern consulting office environment, to be used in the Vision/Values section to build corporate trust.

accessibility.focus: All interactive elements must have focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#0A2E22] focus:outline-none.
accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text, especially within the Diagnostic cards, exceeds WCAG AA contrast against the background.

instructions_to_main_agent: Configure tailwind.config.js to extend fonts 'Poppins' (sans) and 'Caveat' (handwriting).
Install and configure 'lenis' for smooth scrolling globally.
Install 'framer-motion' and use it extensively for the kinetic hero reveal, page transitions, and scrolling reveals.
Use 'sonner' for all toast notifications (e.g., simulated cart success, form submissions).
Do NOT use TypeScript files (no .tsx). Only use standard React .jsx/.js.
Ensure 'Faire mon diagnostic gratuit' is the singular dominant CTA on the home page, styled heavily.
Implement simulated checkout without Stripe. Use local state to handle the cart, followed by a Success/Cancel mockup page.
Add data-testid attributes to all buttons, links, and major forms for testing.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Avoid the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Create depth with layered design, high-contrast typography, and purposeful negative space. Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. DO NOT use generic centered layouts. DO NOT apply 'transition: all' globally. DO NOT center align the app container in global CSS. Always use Sonner for toasts. DO NOT use complete transparent backgrounds for overlapping text/headers. Add data-testid to interactive elements.
